config.loss: mean squared error over all voxels between v_theta(x_t,t) and OCTA-OCT
config.inference_description: Euler8 from OCT, global float32 state and Hann velocity blending on GPU, final-only clamp

identity.inference_protocol: Euler8 from OCT, global float32 state and Hann velocity blending on GPU, final-only clamp

metric_protocol.normalization: parent fixed /255 after Z256 trilinear align_corners=False; no image stretching
metric_protocol.volume: full ZYX256x304x304, float32, range1; MAE/PSNR/3D SSIM
metric_protocol.bscan: each Y slice [Z,X], all304 slices; MAE/PSNR/2D SSIM per slice then volume then patient
metric_protocol.bscan_unpublished_choices: fixed range1, float32, win7 uniform sample covariance; no uint8; not exact TransPro table reproduction
metric_protocol.main_projection: ILM-OPL maximum; native640 voxel centers and closed intervals, inherited exp018
metric_protocol.supplementary_projection: OPL-BM maximum, full-Z mean, full-Z maximum; MAE/PSNR/2D SSIM each
metric_protocol.xoct_float: ILM-BM/ILM-OPL/OPL-BM masked means and full-Z mean; unquantized range1
metric_protocol.xoctstyle: floor(255*x) float32 operands, half-open ILM<=z<OPL and OPL<=z<=BM; masked mean denominator count+1e-6; GT-range normalize each object to255 and clip prediction; MAE units0..255, PSNR/SSIM use GT max-min
metric_protocol.xoctstyle_limit: XOCT eval3d.py/util/eval.py arithmetic on project Z256 grid and fixed split; original ready-made segmentation conversion unpublished; no claim of identical paper protocol; Perp not included
metric_protocol.ssim: 3D for volume, 2D for every projection and B-scan; win7 uniform, use_sample_covariance=True, channel_axis=None
metric_protocol.empty_slab: zero at empty ray for projection evaluation; count reported; training excludes empty rays
metric_protocol.reference_volume: additional unquantized FlowOCT GT.max-GT.min PSNR and 3D SSIM
metric_protocol.aggregation: volume -> within patient -> equal patient macro; all slices before patient macro; no pooled-voxel PSNR
metric_protocol.regions: diagnostic ILM-OPL MIP errors; not TransPro vessel-weighted MAE-V/PSNR-V/SSIM-V
